sources.title: Gemma 4 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 is Google DeepMind's new family of open models, including 12B, E2B, E4B, 26B-A4B, and 31B. The multimodal, hybrid-thinking models support 140+ languages, up to 256K context, and have dense and MoE variants. Gemma 4 is Apache-2.0 licensed and can run on your local device. sources.snippet: You can now train Google's Gemma 4 12B, E2B, E4B, 26B-A4B and 31B with Unsloth. Unsloth supports all vision, text, audio and RL fine-tuning for Gemma 4.

sources.snippet: Overview gemma-4-31B-it-GGUF is a quantized version of Google DeepMind's 31-billion-parameter multimodal language model, packaged in GGUF format by unsloth. This instruction-tuned dense model handles text and image inputs with a 256K token context window, supports 140+ languages, and includes native reasoning modes, function calling, and long-context retrieval.
